set protocols isis level [parameter1].explanation: Configure the level of the ISIS protocol.

wide-metrics-only.explanation: Configure level 2 of the IS-IS protocol to use width only.

set protocols isis graceful-restart.explanation: Enable the graceful restart function for the IS-IS protocol.

set protocols isis spf-interval level [p.explanation: The command configures the SPF (Shortest Path First) calculation interval for IS-IS protocol level 1.

parameters.name: level
parameters.explanation: The level of the IS-IS protocol, where 1 indicates Level 1.

parameters.name: secondary-wait
parameters.explanation: The secondary wait time, measured in milliseconds.

set protocols isis traffic-engineering l.explanation: The flow project for level 2 is activated in the ISIS protocol.

parameters.name: level
parameters.explanation: Level of ISIS agreement, 2 indicates level 2.

set protocols isis interface [parameter1.explanation: Enables an IS-IS protocol on the specified interface.

point-to-point.explanation: Configure the interface type of the IS-IS protocol as a point-to-point.

unit [parameter2].explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address.explanation: The command `family inet address` configures an IPv4 address on a Junos interface, enabling it to participate in IPv4 routing and communication.

family inet address [parameter3]/[parame.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

unit set system security.explanation: The command `set system security` in Junos configures global security settings, including authentication, encryption, and access control for the system.
